'''2007 Worlds Team Team Awesome LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Team Awesome]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Who played under the name ''Team Awesome'' is not identified; the open question is at [[Talk:Team Awesome]].

The sheet's deck title is ''HB''.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Team Awesome]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Stage:''' Team
